card.name: Shortness and frequency of intervals
card.fires_on: Words that describe brief duration or repeated frequency, such as short, spans, changes, every, or hours, when the text is about how often or how briefly something happens.

modes.label: Short durations
modes.description: The word short or a related noun describing brief attention or brief action.
modes.example: You need to think about lots of<< short>> activities when you are planning your lessons.

modes.label: Frequency and intervals
modes.description: Words naming how often something recurs, such as every, hours, or changes.
modes.example: The bank is under the direction of the four reigning burgomasters who are changed<< every>> year.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning every, at intervals, or spread out, such as 每隔 and Every.
card.plain: It marks words about how briefly or how often something happens, such as short spans or every so many hours.
